scope.subject: Delivered MIR 4.7.0 Research Library behavior needed for a bounded MIR5 continuity design.

published_byte_verification.method: SHA-256 of the stated archived entry equals git v4.7.0:<source path>; this is source-to-package custody evidence only.

availability_and_prototype_inputs.feature_gate: research_library; F210 target profile enables it and selects storage runtime state.
availability_and_prototype_inputs.stage_emission: stage/data.lua emits only the Lua shortcut for this library. It uses the Space Age research-productivity icon at 256 when that provider is present, otherwise the base lab icon at 64.
availability_and_prototype_inputs.custom_inputs: No Research Library custom-input declaration was found in its shipped stage source; entry is the Lua shortcut, remote interface, and /mir-research command.

locale_and_assets.other_locales: The package contains locale counterparts; this record pins English as the source reference.
locale_and_assets.browser_specific_raster_assets: none identified; native technology/recipe sprites and utility sprites are addressed by built-in names.

entrypoints.behavior: opens or closes the screen and toggles the shortcut state

native_navigation: open-vanilla closes the browser and calls player.open_technology_gui for the selected technology.
recipe rows call the F210 browser host, which resolves prototypes.recipe[name] and calls player.open_factoriopedia_gui(recipe).
entrypoints_and_native_navigation.research_queue_boundary: The visible GUI tells the player to use the native queue for enqueue/up/down. The separately shipped research_browser_actions helper can validate and write a complete native queue with readback/rollback protection, but the delivered browser click handler does not invoke it.

query_and_details.search: ASCII case-folded, separator-normalized matching over stable id/family and available localized/discovered recipe/material text; source caps text input at 160. Name fallback is stable id until localized index material is ready.
query_and_details.refresh: Typed search is due at tick +6 and served by a three-tick subscription. The provider reports light rows; detail is selected separately. A core development query is paged at 20, while the player list is continuous.
query_and_details.details: Shows native technology identity/icon/cost/science/prerequisites/status plus MIR plan/cap/current-force enrichment, production sample, settings-controller information, affected recipes and availability explanations. Detail expansion bounds are depth 8 and 256 nodes; plain DTO strings are capped at 1024.
query_and_details.scroll_and_focus: No explicit result-list scroll position is saved or restored. Settings, queue and help use ordinary scroll panes. The explicit focus/select-all operation is report text; the search field is not explicitly focused by source.

personal_view_state.legacy_normalization: The source maps unschemed 4.2 family=all and sort=name-asc to family=mir and sort=progression, then normalizes schema, status, visibility, sort, tab and settings scope.

translation_cache_lifetimes.persistent_shape: Per-player plain-data cache: locale and generation, catalogue generation/token, values/search values/search byte count, pending maps, retry queue/count, queue/cursor, outstanding requests, resolved fields, refresh counter and priority token. It keeps no LuaObjects.
translation_cache_lifetimes.lifetime: Each issued id survives close and catalogue/locale invalidation until callback or expiry. Maintenance runs every 61 ticks only while work is outstanding. Close stops dispatch but retains outstanding work; stale or old-generation callbacks release their slot without publishing. Locale/config invalidation increments generation and resets unissued catalogue work. The factorio catalogue force cache is module-memory only and forgets by force.

ui_actions: select research, tabs, family/status/mode/sort/visibility and personal hidden entries
open native technology GUI and Factoriopedia recipe page
actions_and_settings.settings_boundary: Settings tab displays effective startup settings and profile provenance without writing startup values. Checkbox handling may write boolean runtime-player settings or admin runtime-global settings, only for this mod; it rejects startup writes and requires admin for global writes.
file_outputs: Feature-gated settings-profile export: more-infinite-research/settings/browser-profile.txt; this writes an export, not settings mutation.

research: outer scripted-tech dispatch to browser research finished/reversed/queued and force reset/merge handlers
events_and_lifecycles.lifecycle: on_init removes the old mir_browser_open top button and resets shortcut toggles. Configuration change clears force/search pending work, invalidates locale/catalogue generations, removes dead-player caches and preserves translations. on_load only rebinds nth-tick subscriptions from already-saved structures.

dependencies.factorio_provider: Reads force technology/prototype data, with static force cache invalidated by forget_force; uses F210 prototypes, production statistics, Factoriopedia, helpers.write_file and storage.

native_evidence_still_required: shortcut opens/closes the actual F210 screen and preserves shortcut toggle semantics
filter/search/list/detail rendering, deferred refresh and localized translation callback behavior
runtime setting permissions and file export behavior
F210 save/reload and an upgrade migration retaining the identified personal-state fields
